messages.subject: Time recording — January narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
A reminder that January time entries must be finalised by 5pm on 2 February. Several fee-earners have unposted time and missing narratives. Please ensure all matters are up to date so we can run the month-end bill run.

Thank you,
Accounts
